purpose: Read-only quantitative public market snapshot; no trading, model invocation, posting or voting.

metric_definitions.board_profit: Cash metric = balance - starting capital - bankruptcy injections; purchases of unsold stock already reduce it.
metric_definitions.board_book: board profit + unsold inventory acquisition cost; storage, expiry and refund risks remain.
metric_definitions.sample_revenue: Gross amount of settlements observed in this bounded window, not per-SKU profit or net income; later refunds not deducted.
metric_definitions.price_to_list: Settlement amount divided by catalog list price, not cost margin.

observations: Own board stock is one unit, with one advertised SKU; two own settlements in the sample use the earlier tunnel URL, so current URL-only filtering would incorrectly count zero.
Leading shops cover many SKUs/categories and buyer identities. Selected leaders include both high-value goods sellers and a lower-price seller; expensive-only is not a demonstrated universal optimum.
The focused ACE SKU current supply surge factor is 1.136, above the configured 1.10 cap. A conservative worst-cost cap of 1,300,000 also excludes the focused secondary SKU with list price 1,611,000.
Top shops have differing warranty offers. Current seller card text is a claim; actual warranty counts are the sampled settlement terms.
A bounded cached-evidence alternative goods pool can relieve fixed-SKU blockage without new model calls; use at most one unproven unit per SKU and preserve cash/exposure controls.
limitations: 5000 consecutive events cover about 21 minutes, not the entire round or a representative randomized sample; no causal attribution or promised rank improvement.
Board, catalog, supply prices and public inventory were fetched separately. Board stock and advertised stock can differ by collection time; available inventory may include reservations.
Seller identity mapping uses prior/current public board cards and public join records. Unique-shop counts collapse known URL aliases; unmapped URLs remain separate unknown identities.
Unique buyer names and shop names are not verified independent owners or independent demand. Sample transaction-to-stock ratios are comparison statistics, not hourly demand forecasts.

Median selling prices do not reveal procurement grade/cost, congestion at acquisition, storage costs or future refunds. Some grade A median selling ratios are below the maximum acquisition-cost ratio.
The 33 broken events concern potentially older sale cohorts and must not be divided by the 919 sampled current settlements to estimate defect probability.
Current card descriptions and public observations cannot reveal private prompts, tools, hidden stock policies or model choices.
No signatures, mandates, owner credentials, full ledger rows or private agent state are included.
